text: ふぁいへんひゃ　ふへほ　はんひ　ひへは　ほはへへ　ひほうはッ！

structure.jp: ほはへへ　ひほうはッ！
structure.en: (おとして しもうた) I've gone and dropped them!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: ほはへへ　ひほうは
patterns.explanation: Without his teeth, he is saying おとして しもうた, an old-man form of おとしてしまった. てしまう says the thing happened completely, to your regret. おとして しもうた = 'I went and dropped them'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: This is たいへんじゃ said without teeth. じゃ is the way old men in stories say だ, 'is'. たいへんじゃ = 'it's terrible'.
